results.title: Is the AI bubble bursting just as Anthropic goes public?
results.content: The sharp sell-off in tech stocks after the US midterms and the Nvidia scandal has cast doubt on Anthropic's IPO. Yet with hundreds of billions still being invested, some think the AI party is still in full swing.

results.title: Almost 1 in 4 children live in conflict zones — report
results.content: Denial of humanitarian access, abductions and sexual violence are among several violations against children that have increased dramtically over the past year, according to a new report by Save the Children.

results.title: North Korea expanded uranium enrichment plant, says IAEA head
results.content: IAEA chief Rafael Grossi has said the ongoing expansion of North Korea's uranium enrichment program remains "a cause for serious concern."

results.title: India: Online censorship grows after 'Cockroach' protests
results.content: Since anti-government Cockroach protests erupted, journalists and creators say their content is increasingly being restricted on social media in India.

results.title: ICJ to rule on Rohingya genocide case against Myanmar: What to know
results.content: The ICJ is set to decide whether Myanmar's military operations in Rakhine State a decade ago were carried out with the intent to destroy the country's Rohingya minority, in whole or in part.

results.title: Axes and cutlasses: Violence on Nigeria's election campaign trail
results.content: As Nigeria's January 2027 elections approach, political violence and thuggery at campaign rallies and town hall meetings raise concerns about voter safety.

results.title: Latin America's mega-prisons: Can El Salvador's model work?
results.content: El Salvador's mega-prison has become a model for governments across Latin America seeking to combat organized crime. But experts question whether the approach is effective, sustainable or compatible with human rights.

results.title: APEC summit: What Trump, Xi and Putin want
results.content: Trump, Xi and Putin will hold their first trilateral meeting on the sidelines of APEC. With different priorities on trade, Ukraine, Iran and arms control, what does each leader hope to gain?

results.title: Hashim Thaci's second conviction in The Hague reignites debate in Kosovo about justice and the Kosovo Specialist Chambers
results.content: Former President Hashim Thaci has been convicted of trying to influence witnesses in his war crimes trial. The conviction has reignited debate in Kosovo about the Kosovo Specialist Chambers, the court that convicted him.

results.title: EU, ASEAN pursue deeper trade ties, but hurdles remain as businesses struggle with informal barriers
results.content: 2027 could be a landmark year for EU–Southeast Asia trade, with several deals nearing completion. But the harder task will be to ensure that businesses actually use them.

results.title: Saudi Arabia: Rights groups raise alarm over rising number of executions
results.content: Amid the war in Iran, Saudi Arabia's human rights situation remains bleak, with at least 211 executions, corporal punishment and an intensifying crackdown on critics. Is the regional conflict driving domestic repression?
